question: Which one of the following statements is false? All equilateral triangles are
solution:
An equilateral triangle has three equal sides and three \(60^\circ\) angles. It is therefore equiangular, isosceles because it has at least two equal sides, and regular because all its sides and angles are equal. Thus A, B, and C are true.

Any two equilateral triangles also have equal corresponding angles. If their side lengths are \(s>0\) and \(t>0\), all three corresponding side ratios equal \(s/t\), so the triangles are similar. Thus E is true.

Congruence requires equal size as well as equal shape. Equilateral triangles with side lengths \(1\) and \(2\) have different sizes and cannot be congruent. Therefore the false statement is “congruent to each other,” choice D.
